quests.dispatcherQuestion: A warehouse worker's foot is trapped under a fallen pallet of boxes. Input rescue code!
quests.hint: Say what must be done to free his foot.
quests.explanation: Lifting the load slowly and carefully frees him without causing further injury to the trapped foot.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Storm winds have blown a large tree branch onto a parked school bus. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say what must happen before anything else.
quests.explanation: Checking everyone on board for injuries comes first, before dealing with the branch itself.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A passenger has collapsed on a crowded train between stations. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say where the train should stop for help to board.
quests.explanation: Getting to the next station quickly lets paramedics board and treat him without delay.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A camper's tent has caught fire from a portable stove. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Say the first safety step before fighting the fire.
quests.explanation: Getting everyone clear of the flames comes before any attempt to put the fire out.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman with diabetes is shaking, sweating, and cannot speak clearly. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the vehicle that can treat him on the way to hospital.
quests.explanation: These are signs of dangerously low blood sugar, which paramedics can treat within minutes of arriving.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Two men are seen loading electronics from a warehouse into an unmarked van. Input police code!
quests.hint: Say who's needed, and where.
quests.explanation: A patrol car can respond fast enough to check whether the men have permission to be there.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A power cut has stopped a man's home oxygen machine from working. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Stress both the team needed and the urgency.
quests.explanation: Paramedics carry portable oxygen and can support him safely until his power supply is restored.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Heavy rain has flooded a underpass with a car stuck inside it. Input rescue code!
quests.hint: Ask for the specialists trained for this exact rescue.
quests.explanation: Floodwater can rise fast in a low underpass, so a trained rescue team must reach the car quickly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A fire alarm is sounding in a crowded shopping center on a Saturday. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Get everyone out before checking anything else.
quests.explanation: With a crowd this size, getting everyone out calmly and quickly is always the first priority.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man has mixed bleach and ammonia while cleaning and is coughing badly. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say the first step, before any medical treatment.
quests.explanation: Fresh air away from the fumes is the first step before anything else can help him.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A cricket ball has struck a spectator hard on the side of the head. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Name the vehicle that carries paramedics.
quests.explanation: Any hard blow to the head needs a paramedic assessment, even if he seems fine at first.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man is seen breaking a car window with a hammer in a parking garage. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for the extra support officers need.
quests.explanation: A break-in like this needs a fast police response before the man can take anything and leave.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman has gone into labor early on a long-distance bus. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for help urgently, using the word 'now'.
quests.explanation: Paramedics are trained to assist a birth safely and can meet the bus at the nearest stop.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A faulty vending machine has given a customer an electric shock. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say what must be cut off first.
quests.explanation: Cutting the machine's power removes the shock risk before anyone checks on the customer.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A group of boys is throwing bottles from a footbridge onto the road below. Input police code!
quests.hint: Name the service that responds to crime.
quests.explanation: This puts drivers in real danger, so a patrol car should respond before someone is hurt.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man has chest pain and pain running down his left arm at work. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask plainly for someone trained to treat them.
quests.explanation: Pain spreading down the arm is a classic heart attack sign, so help must be sent immediately.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A faulty heater has filled a caravan with smoke overnight. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Say the first thing that must happen to the occupants.
quests.explanation: Getting everyone into fresh air is the priority before checking what caused the smoke.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman reports her car has been keyed along the entire side. Input police code!
quests.hint: Say what the officer should do first, even without theft.
quests.explanation: A written report of the damage is needed for her insurance claim, even though nothing was taken.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A swimmer has been pulled from a lake and is not breathing. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say the life-saving action to begin immediately.
quests.explanation: Starting CPR right away keeps blood moving to the brain until paramedics can take over.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A faulty scoreboard has short-circuited and is smoking above a football pitch. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Say the first safety step for the players and crowd.
quests.explanation: Clearing people from underneath removes the risk of sparks or falling debris hurting anyone.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man's phone was snatched from his hand while he waited at a crosswalk. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for a police vehicle already on the road.
quests.explanation: A quick response gives police the best chance of finding the phone or the person nearby.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A worker has inhaled fumes from a freshly painted storeroom and feels dizzy. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say the first step, before any medical treatment.
quests.explanation: Fresh air away from the fumes is the first step before treating any remaining symptoms.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A small fire has started in a recycling bin behind a supermarket. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name the service that puts out fires.
quests.explanation: Bin fires can spread to nearby walls or bins, so a properly equipped crew should attend.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A driver reports a car overtaking dangerously and forcing others off the road. Input police code!
quests.hint: Let the police know what you're seeing.
quests.explanation: Reporting dangerous driving while it's happening helps police locate and stop the vehicle quickly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A child has a severe nut allergy and just ate food from an unlabeled dish. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the medical team by name.
quests.explanation: Without knowing what's in the food, paramedics should be sent in case a reaction begins quickly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A burst water main is flooding a residential street and rising fast. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say who needs to leave first.
quests.explanation: Homes at the lowest point of the street are at greatest risk, so they should be evacuated first.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman reports a man exposing himself to passersby in a park. Input police code!
quests.hint: Send the service that handles this kind of incident.
quests.explanation: A quick police response can stop the behavior and keep other park visitors safe.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man has a fish bone stuck in his throat at a seafood restaurant. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the medical team, and add urgency.
quests.explanation: Paramedics have the tools to remove a stuck object safely without pushing it in further.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Faulty Christmas lights have sparked and caught a dry tree alight indoors. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Say the first thing that must be cut off.
quests.explanation: Cutting the power source first stops the fire from being fed while help is called.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A resident reports a man peering through windows along their street at night. Input police code!
quests.hint: Send an official police vehicle to the scene.
quests.explanation: A patrol car can check the area and reassure residents that someone is looking into it.
